With the dashboard overlay you can copy parts of you screen and show them at other locations. You could use it for example to show your skill cooldowns at the top of your screen.

It works by creating a live thumbnail for every region you are interested in.

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/josdemmers/Diablo4Companion/refs/heads/master/readme/wiki-dashboard-001.png" height="300">

1. Add a new thumbnail.
2. List of all your thumbnails. Left click to select one to modify it's position. Right click to disable it.
3. Toggle the dashboard overlay on/off.
4. Create a new screenshot.
5. Switch between the source and destination region. You can drag the regions on the screenshot to move them to your preferred location.
6. When enabled this shows all thumbnails on your screenshot instead of only the selected one.
7. Position information of the currently selected thumbnail. For the destination region you can also set the alpha value (opacity).

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/josdemmers/Diablo4Companion/refs/heads/master/readme/wiki-dashboard-002.png" height="300">

To get started create a new screenshot [4], after that create a new thumbnail [1]. Use the screenshot to move the source and destination regions to your preferred location. Use the source and destination toggle buttons to switch between the region you want to move.
When you are done press [5] to enable the dashboard overlay.
